spans.s:
mūrkhá, a. stupid, foolish; as m. fool.
[√mūrch, mg 3.]

√mūrch (mū́rchati; mumū́rcha; mūrchitá,
mūrtá [220^2]). become rigid:
 —1. coagulate, acquire consistency; and
so
 —2. take shape, be formed;
 —3. (become
stiff, numb, torpid, and so) become
stupid, senseless. [for mg 3, cf. Eng.
torpid, ‘numb,’ and then ‘dull, stupid’:
see mūrti and mūrkha.]

mū́rti, f. firm body, definite shape, embodiment.
 [√mūrch, 220^2.]

mūrtimant, a. having bodily form, incarnate.
 [mūrti, 1235.]
